summary: One test failed due to the contact form element not being found and thus not visible within the timeout period.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator 'form[data-test="contact-form"]' did not find any matching element on the page, causing the visibility check to time out.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify accessibility of the contact form
failedTests.errorMessage: Error: expect(locator('form[data-test="contact-form"]').toBeVisible()) failed. Locator did not find any element within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector mismatch - the selector 'form[data-test="contact-form"]' does not match any element on the page at test runtime.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector 'form[data-test="contact-form"]' is correct and matches the current application DOM. Update the selector if the application markup has changed or ensure the form is rendered before the check.

recommendations: Review and validate the selector 'form[data-test="contact-form"]' against the current application UI.
Check if the contact form is conditionally rendered or delayed in loading and adjust test timing or add waits accordingly.
If the application UI has changed, update the test selectors to reflect the new structure.
Review the attached screenshot and trace files for additional context on the failure.
releaseImpact: High - The failure indicates that a critical UI element (contact form) is not accessible or not present, which could block user interactions and impact release quality.
